meta.title: NexusFi — Financial management for businesses
meta.description: Centralize your company's finances: cash flow, payables and receivables, automated reports and cost control.
meta.ogDescription: A complete platform to organize your company's finances with real-time data.

hero.subtitle: Centralize your company's finances: cash flow, payables and receivables, automated reports and cost control — all in one simple, powerful platform.
hero.socialProof: 500+ companies already run their finances on NexusFi

problem.body: Most companies still manage finances in scattered spreadsheets, with the risk of errors, rework and no visibility. NexusFi fixes that for good.
painPoints: Hard to control costs by area

features.title: Everything your company's finance team needs
features.subtitle: Integrated modules built for SMBs, startups and growing companies.

items.title: Real-time cash flow
items.desc: See your company's inflows, outflows and cash-flow projections on dashboards that update automatically.

items.title: Automated financial reports
items.desc: Income statement, balance sheet and management reports generated automatically from your entries.

items.title: Payables and receivables
items.desc: Manage due dates, issue invoices and track overdue accounts all in one place, with smart alerts.

items.title: Cost centers and budgeting
items.desc: Categorize expenses by department, set budget targets and monitor variances in real time.

items.title: Multi-user and permissions
items.desc: Role-based access: admin, finance, manager. Each teammate sees only what they need.

items.title: Marketplace integration
items.desc: Connect Mercado Livre and Shopee: every sale flows automatically into cash flow, with fees and payouts already posted.

pricing.title: Choose the right plan for your company
pricing.subtitle: Free <accent>7-day trial</accent> on any plan. No credit card, no commitment.

modal.title: Billing period
modal.body: Monthly or annual — you choose how you'd rather pay, and you can change it later.

cta.body: 7 days free, setup in under 5 minutes, human support included.

items.name: Marcos Oliveira
items.text: We eliminated manual spreadsheets and cut the time spent on monthly close by 40%. Full visibility into the business.

items.name: Patrícia Mendes
items.text: Cost-center tracking helped us find where we were losing margin. The result: a 23% cut in expenses.

items.name: Bruno Castilho
items.text: Perfect for firms. I send reports to the partners in minutes, with reliable data that's visually clear.

footer.tagline: Complete financial management for businesses: cash flow, accounts and reports in one place.
